name: Toledo Museum of Art (1912, Green & Wicks; wings 1926, 1933), 2445 Monroe St
refs: refs/w233893958/00 (Toledo Museum of Art exterior 01, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Greek Revival in white Vermont marble: a raised base storey with small windows and the entrances, a long giant Ionic colonnade across the Monroe St front carrying a plain entablature, blank marble walls behind (galleries are top-lit), green copper roof edge.
